items.title: Jillean Williams interviewed by Milt Fillius and Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, May 20, 1995
items.q: His brother Jimmy lives in Las Vegas. Jimmy Wilkins. He has a band.

ctx.x: I thought so, the musician’s union had a Denmark address.
His brother Jimmy lives in Las Vegas. Jimmy Wilkins. He has a band.
And the musicians in England would pick up on American styles, mostly from record I would imagine.
